anchors.description: White six-panel interior door leaf at the right side, open into the kitchen; measure the hinge-side vertical stile from the top edge of the leaf to its bottom edge at the threshold.
anchors.visible_evidence: The full white interior door leaf is visible from its top edge at the head casing down to its bottom edge meeting the floor threshold; both endpoints sit on the same vertical hinge-side stile, so the 3D straight-line distance equals the leaf height.
anchors.identity_uncertainty: Standard US residential interior hinged door height is 80 in (2.03 m); at this resolution the exact top/bottom edge rows are uncertain by a few pixels, and an 84 in (2.13 m) door cannot be fully excluded.
